cohort: Eight young women (mean age 28.5 in VR group, 30.5 in control) undergoing elective cesarean delivery under epidural analgesia.
finding: Patients receiving VR relaxation experienced a 91.89% pain reduction during elective cesarean delivery, while the control group showed a 61% increase in pain.
mod_finding: VR supplemented pain mitigation provides high levels of satisfaction to mothers during elective cesarean delivery and carries no risk for the newborns.
